_description: ISCA'27 quick trials Q2 (P19): v4m3 + reader-bitmap push of hot-broadcast pages (geo-push mode readers): the owner keeps per-page 48-bit reader bitmaps of the current and previous 5 us window (1024 pages, LRU) and pushes the lines of a hot page it serves to those readers along the multicast tree; receivers install them into invalid L2 ways as M3 replicas. Hot = online rule (>= 4 readers in a window); add -q2-pages <file> for the oracle pgcls classification. See mgpusim/timing/rdma/geo_readers.go.
